title: A global connective derived model computing higher direct images and their base changes
statement: Let f:X→T be a proper, locally finitely presented, quasi-compact morphism of schemes and F a finitely presented O_X-module flat over T. Use the ordinary module pullback of [def-pc-module-pullback], the derived pullback of [def-pc-derived-pullback], and derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume injective resolutions in X.Modules, and choose shared derived-category localization models for all schemes. There exists E∈D(O_T) with H^n(E)=0 for n<0, with H^q(E) isomorphic to R^q f_*F for every natural q, and with H^q(Lg^*E) isomorphic to R^q f'_*(g'^*F) for every cartesian square (g',f',f,g), every natural q, and injective resolutions on X'. No concentration or perfect-locus hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Take E=Rf_*(F[0]) using the ringed-space derived direct image. Embed an injective resolution of F in nonnegative integer degrees. Bounded-below complexes of injectives are K-injective, so the derived pushforward is computed by applying f_* to it. The degree-q comparison is the right-derived-functor comparison (the existing abstract source-library homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso is a reusable ingredient), and negative cohomology is zero. Transport between the equivalent Scheme.Modules and shared sheaf category constructions.

Apply the derived arbitrary-base-change assertion for relatively flat finitely presented modules. Transport the standard categorical pullback along sq.isoPullback and the ordinary pullback composition comparisons. Taking degree-q cohomology and using the same injective-resolution comparison on X' gives the asserted isomorphism for the chosen square. These are global derived objects and maps, so no gluing of unrelated local trivializations is used.

lean.statement: theorem exists_derived_model_higherDirectImage [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] [F.IsFinitePresentation] (hF : F.IsFlatOver f) : ∃ E : schemeDerivedCategory T, (∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E)) ∧ (∀ q : ℕ, Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) q).obj E ≅ (higherDirectImage f q).obj F)) ∧ ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ T) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T') [HasInjectiveResolutions X'.Modules], IsPullback g' f' f g → ∀ q : ℕ, Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) q).obj ((derivedPullback g).obj E) ≅ (higherDirectImage f' q).obj ((Modules.pullback g').obj F))
